verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows generic OAuth client-ID/secret-to-access-token exchange for the REST API (paypal-docs-1/18) and an Agent Toolkit/MCP server for agent integration (paypal-gh-1/2, paypal-docs-10), but nothing describes issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials specifically for an AI agent (e.g., restricted permission sets, granular API scopes, or per-agent credential controls). Missing for 10: documented scope/permission granularity for API apps, agent-specific credential restriction mechanisms, any least-privilege configuration guidance.
